stem.text: Different antibiotics function in different ways. It is important that the antibiotic kills the bacteria, but does not harm the infected human.
The antibiotic tetracycline has been found to affect the way in which human mitochondria function.
Which statements could explain why human mitochondria function is affected by tetracycline?

A.text: The antibiotic prevents the synthesis of peptidoglycan cell walls.

B.text: The antibiotic prevents synthesis of linear DNA.

C.text: The antibiotic prevents translation of circular DNA.

D.text: The antibiotic prevents translation by binding to 70S ribosomes.
